title: Amazon’s data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water last year
brief: Amazon revealed its data centers consumed 2.5 billion gallons of water globally in 2025, a 2% decrease from 2024 despite operational expansion, with a consumption rate of 0.12 liters per kilowatt-hour. The disclosure comes as Seattle imposes a one-year data center moratorium and environmental scrutiny of AI infrastructure intensifies around water and energy use.
